description: 实验性测试模组：新增第三层敌人“镜像决斗家”，会复制角色外观、偷取并使用玩家卡牌。Bug 较多，作者目前暂时摆烂、暂停维护；不保证兼容性，请勿用于重要存档。 Experimental test build: the Mirror Duelist copies your character and steals/plays your cards. Many bugs remain; development is currently on hold. Use at your own risk.
